text:
maria: heads up — the firewall tiering rollout to eu-prod just went out and we're seeing a bunch of GPU nodes fail to join the warm pool. errors look like keystore authz failures (403) over privatelink.
jon: ack. can you paste the keystore error blob from one of the nodes?
maria: log snippet:
```
keystore-client: request to https://priv-keystore.eu.internal/decrypt failed: 403 Forbidden {"reason":"principal not allowed by firewall-tier"}
node-id: gpu-eu-004
```
kevin: looks like the new firewall tiers are dropping the service principal used by the keystore proxy. that's what prevents STS/kms handshake.
anya: is this the same tiering rule that denies cross-subnet service CIDR for non-controlplane?
maria: yes — policy change added a deny for privatelink subnets unless explicitly allowlisted. we didn't add the keystore proxy principal to the allowlist.
jon: quick mitigations: 1) add allowlist entry for keystore proxy principal, 2) roll back tiering change, or 3) route keystore traffic via mgmt-bastion (ugh). which do we prefer for immediate recovery?
kevin: safest fast path is allowlist only — low blast radius and no infra deploy. ops can flip that in idp console.
anya: will that re-enable node joins immediately?
kevin: yes, once keystore can decrypt node bootstrap secrets nodes will join. but we should also plan a postmortem: why didn't canary catch this?
maria: canary was limited to controlplane subnets; warm-pool lives in worker subnets so missed it.
sre-bot: runbook suggestion: https://internal.runbooks/redwood/keystore-authz-failure — step 2 covers allowlist workaround.
jon: can someone make the allowlist change and report back? @kevin? :pray:
kevin: on it. applying allowlist for principal arn:aws:iam::123456789:role/keystore-proxy to eu privatelink now.
deploy-bot: firewall-tiering-rollout: pause requested by kevin at 2024-07-03T14:09:02Z
kevin: done, propagation should take ~30s. watching nodes.
maria: seeing node join for gpu-eu-004, 005, 006. warm pool trending back to normal. thanks.
anya: next steps: 1) update canary to include worker subnet keystore calls, 2) add automated smoke check for keystore decrypt during node join, 3) document principal allowlist as part of rollout checklist.
jon: also need cost note: allowlisting increases permitted surface — product asked about audit implications. we should add an audit log event and a ticket to eng-security to review policy.
kevin: created ticket SEC-4521 with required audit events + timeline.
maria: final: leaving firewall rollout paused until we've validated canary + smoke checks in staging. anyone object?
anya: no objections. thanks for fast patching everyone. :thumbsup:
kevin: follow-up: I'll publish a short postmortem after we collect logs and confirm no other principals are affected.
sre-bot: alert cleared: keystore-proxy auth failures resolved for eu-prod.
